scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS)
provider_name: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
benefit_description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for regular college/university students. Rates: Rs 12,000/yr for first three years of graduation; Rs 20,000/yr at post-graduation; Rs 20,000/yr in 4th and 5th year of professional/integrated 5-year courses.
eligibility_text: Above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream of the respective Class 12 Board; pursuing a regular course; not availing any other scholarship including state scholarships or fee waiver/reimbursement; gross parental/family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh per annum.
eligible_course: Regular graduation, post-graduation and professional courses at recognised colleges/universities
notes: Content seen as search excerpts of education.gov.in and myScheme (https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/csss-cus); pages not fully fetched. benefit_amount shows the graduation rate; PG and years 4-5 are Rs 20,000. An older guideline mentions Rs 10,000/yr for 2021-22 awards. Guideline PDF seen only on an NIT website (non-ministry host) so guideline_url left empty. Current-year window and deadline not confirmed.

scheme_name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
provider_name: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education
benefit_description: One lakh fresh scholarships per year for Class IX students, continued through Classes X-XII via renewal, to reduce drop-out after Class VIII. Paid by DBT through NSP/PFMS.
eligibility_text: Parental income from all sources not more than Rs 3,50,000 per annum; minimum 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in Class VII to appear in the selection test (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST); regular student of a State Government, Government-aided or local body school; students of NVS, KVS and residential schools not entitled; must pass the state MAT and SAT with at least 40% aggregate (32% for SC/ST). Renewal needs at least 60% in Class X (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST) and promotion in first attempt.
eligible_course: Class IX to XII in State Government, Government-aided and local body schools
notes: Official ministry page fetched in full on 2026-10-21; scheme terms verified from it. Page states continuation was approved for FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26; continuation beyond that NOT confirmed. Each State/UT runs its own selection test and reservation. Past NSP deadlines seen (e.g. 15 Nov 2024 for 2024-25) are historical only. Current-year application window not confirmed. No required-documents list on the page.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Castes (Centrally Sponsored)
provider_name: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_description: Financial assistance to SC students at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to complete their education; implemented through State Governments/UT administrations.
eligibility_text: Belongs to a Scheduled Caste specified for the State/UT where the applicant actually belongs/is domiciled; passed Matriculation/Higher Secondary or a higher examination of a recognised board/university; parents'/guardians' income from all sources not exceeding Rs 2,50,000 per annum; Indian nationals only; study in India in recognised post-matric courses; may not hold any other scholarship/stipend.
notes: Direct fetch of the myScheme page returned no content (JavaScript-rendered); eligibility taken from search excerpts of that page plus the income limit from https://transformingindia.mygov.in/scheme/post-matric-scholarship-for-scheduled-caste-students/. Benefit amount, documents, application URL and dates not captured. State-run variants listed on myScheme (e.g. Gujarat, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh) are separate schemes and not merged here.

eligible_course: Technical and professional courses at undergraduate and postgraduate level

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
provider_name: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_description: Income support of Rs 6,000 per year per family in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 every four months, by DBT.
eligibility_text: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names (family = husband, wife and minor children). Excluded: institutional landholders; families with members who hold or held constitutional posts or are/were ministers, MPs, MLAs, mayors or district panchayat chairpersons; serving or retired government officers/employees (excluding MTS/Class IV/Group D); pensioners with monthly pension Rs 10,000 or more; persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year; registered professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs, architects.
notes: Source is a government-run information portal (vikaspedia), not the pmkisan.gov.in site itself, which was not accessed. An older pmkisan FAQ (fw.pmkisan.gov.in) limits eligibility to up to 2 hectares; the later rule covers all landholding families. Current rules, KYC/e-KYC and land-seeding requirements NOT checked. Ongoing scheme; no deadline.
